positive_cases.prompt: 患者队列记录了三个医院的报告等待时间；另访谈各院技师和医生解释工作流差异，两边没有患者 ID 联结。按场所和构念整合是否可行？
required_checks: declare site or construct integration level and distinct populations
traceable integrated narrative or joint display
no invented patient keys or individual-level association

positive_cases.prompt: 设计访谈研究，了解乳腺 MRI 假阳性复查对患者决策和检查体验的影响。
required_checks: experience not prevalence or clinical effectiveness

positive_cases.prompt: 为多院 CT 技师焦点小组制定方案，研究协议偏离、夜班压力和重扫决策。
审计急诊影像工作流民族志：作者只观察了两个下午，却声称完整解释夜间中断和升级机制。
冻结放射科医生阅读 AI 热图时 think-aloud 的方法和局限，用于论文 Methods。

合并报告周转时间数据与放射科医生观察访谈，制作 convergent joint display 并解释不一致。
required_checks: shared construct unit and time window

positive_cases.prompt: 先发现 AI 对低年资读者帮助更大，再目的抽样访谈解释这种异质性。
先用患者访谈形成影像检查负担条目，再开发量表并进行定量验证。

boundary_cases.prompt: 让五位医生试用界面后随口说说感受，只整理三条产品建议，不做研究推断。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: FORMATIVE_FEEDBACK_ONLY unless a full qualitative research contract is requested

boundary_cases.prompt: 对已经写好的 30 项问卷做探索性因子分析、信度和测量不变性。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: quantitative psychometrics is not qualitative analysis

boundary_cases.prompt: 替访谈项目判断是否豁免伦理审查并批准录音同意。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: the skill cannot confer exemption or approval

boundary_cases.prompt: 将访谈中展示的 DICOM 和报告去标识后打包共享。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: de-identification and release are data-governance tasks

boundary_cases.prompt: 根据一位患者访谈决定她是否还要做增强 MRI。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: participant account cannot authorize individual care

boundary_cases.prompt: 不审方法，只把这段定性研究 Results 润色成英文。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: prose editing is not methodological ownership

boundary_cases.prompt: 设计 5000 例 CT 队列并计算诊断模型样本量。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: quantitative cohort design is outside this skill

invariants: Participant linkage is required only when the inference uses participant-level linkage
Design construct and interpretation integration may use different samples without invented person keys
A traceable integrated narrative may enact integration without a mandatory table
The phenomenon decision and claim are frozen before method selection
Usability feedback is not automatically a qualitative study
Purposeful sampling does not establish statistical representativeness
Information power is iterative and is not a fixed sample-size calculator
Saturation is named operationalised and evidenced rather than asserted
Participant quotations and observations remain distinct from analytic interpretation
Themes are interpretations rather than untouched facts that simply emerge
Method-congruent rigor replaces universal demands for inter-coder agreement
Member checking has a defined purpose and is not a truth certificate
Negative and deviant cases test the boundary of an interpretation
Software use does not establish qualitative rigor
Think-aloud evidence retains reactivity and verbalisation limits
A brief site visit is not silently relabelled workflow ethnography
Mixed methods requires an explicit integration point
Convergent explanatory-sequential and exploratory-sequential designs remain distinct
Joint displays trace each meta-inference to both strands
Discordance is investigated and may remain unresolved
A larger or numeric strand does not automatically override the other strand
Integration cannot repair an invalid constituent strand
Qualitative acceptance does not establish safety effectiveness or cost-effectiveness
Radiology roles image versions workflow context and site shifts remain visible
Ethics approval data governance and individual patient care remain external
